products.name: Denver iD Pole
products.manufacturerNote: Manufactured by Holophane (UK). Lumen Method is the exclusive Holophane specification agent for Australia.
products.tagline: Post-top LED area luminaire with patented Transition Zone glare control, built for pedestrian-friendly amenity spaces.
products.summary: Denver iD Pole is a two-part die-cast aluminium post-top luminaire covering 2,000–12,000 delivered lumens across five optical distributions. A patented Transition Zone softens the LED array's visual signature, while a fully removable LED module keeps the fixture serviceable in the field.

keySpecs.value: Individual PMMA lenses, patented Transition Zone diffuser

keySpecs.label: Smart controls
keySpecs.value: ZD4i-ready, 4-pin Zhaga socket (TZ01/TZ02), Controlux Air compatible

keySpecs.label: Warranty / life rating
keySpecs.value: L70 control gear options: 70% / 80% / 90% lumen maintenance over life

dimensions.note: Both body sizes share a 116mm height. Weight and windage are per-fitting, excluding bracket.

accessories.desc: External back light shield, 125mm — finished in .C1 / .C4 / .C6 / .C7 / .C9

mountingHeights.note: Suitable from 3m to 8m mounting heights. Range figures are typical spacing guidance, not a substitute for a lighting design calculation.

certifications: IDA Dark Sky Approved (3000K or warmer)
